title: AlphaSense Occupies New Global HQ at Hudson Commons, NYC
source: PR Newswire / Crain's New York Business
summary: AlphaSense began occupying its new global HQ at Hudson Commons (441 Ninth Avenue) in early 2026, following a June 2025 announcement of its 10-year, 50,000 sq ft lease with expansion rights to 100,000 sq ft. The space seats 300 employees to serve ~500 NYC staff.
